See also: ObjectsHelp
You see a great health potion.
It weighs 3.10 oz.
This potion can only be consumed by knights of level 80 or higher.

  • Aaaah...

Notes

It has a deposit of 5 gp and restores between 425 and 575 Hit Points, around 500 on average.
See also: Money Spent per Hit Point and Capacity Taken per Hit Point

Because they drop frequently from many different monsters, they’re often available on the market for about half their NPC price.

History

  • The price was further increased from 200 gp to 225 gp with the Summer 2024 Update on Jul 01, 2024.
  • The price was increased from 190 gp to 200 gp, additionally the Store prices were also raised with the update on October 29, 2018 shown below.
    • 100x Great Health Potions went from 15 Tibia Coins to 18 Tibia Coins.
    • 250x Great Health Potions went from 34 Tibia Coins to 41 Tibia Coins.
  • The price was decreased from 250 gp to 190 gp with the 8.11 Update, additionally the average amount healed was dropped from 600 Hit Points to 500 Hit Points on Apr 08, 2008.
